values.note: Read on Campspot, 2 adults, 30/50 Amp RV Site (31-32 sites, most 30-50 ft; 53 and 73 are 20 ft): June 2027 $30 on a Tuesday (one night $38 total, two $68), $33 on a Saturday ($41 total). Plus the park's $8 'New Reservation Fee', once per stay. Read 2026-10-31.
One night from a Saturday is refused on Campspot in May, June and August 2027 (minimum-stay rule).

hookups.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/turkeyruncanoeandcamping (30/50 Amp RV Site amenities: 30-Amp, 50-Amp, Electricity, no water or sewer; 'one shared electric pedestal'; the map draws water spigots at the loop). Water and sewer came from note prose, cleared

sites.source: https://turkeyruncanoeandcamping.com/ ('Equipped with 125 sites') + https://www.campspot.com/book/turkeyruncanoeandcamping (site lengths to 50 ft; 'NOT ALL SITES ARE PULL THROUGH')

summary: $30-33 and $8 fee confirmed for 2027. Water/sewer cleared: electric only. Saturday 2-night minimum added; 50 ft added; 125 confirmed. Note trimmed.
flags: GATE: $30 weekday, $33 Saturday, $8 fee. Passes. Not borderline on price. No gateway within 40 km (Indianapolis 92 km). Phone 765-597-2029 matches site and Google. Good Sam not stated.

GOOGLE: 4.1 from 417 reviews. Mixed in the five read: 'No water was supplied (no pumps worked). No grey water dump site... No full hook up, only electric. The price was insane for the lack of amenities' and $10 per extra person and per dog (a month ago); 'very crowded... no shade' (3 months); 'felt targeted by their security' (a month); two warmer. 'They know that people accidently book theirs instead of the DNR camp ground.'
DUMP: stored true (note prose); operator's page doesn't mention one; a recent review says none. Left alone, needs a phone call.
ELECTRIC: 'one shared electric pedestal' per site, first come first serve on the plug.

Most of the 125 are tent, walk-in and electric-tent sites; RV type is ~32. RV pads are open gravel on imagery ('wooded' dropped from the note). Not waterfront stands: Sugar Creek is about 450 m south across a road and field. PIN at entrance ~130 m from the rows, fine.
note: Gravel-pad sites 2 miles west of Turkey Run State Park, with a canoe livery on Sugar Creek; the sites are set back from the creek. --Claude
